answer: One strong defence is slow, attested work history. An agent gains influence only by completing tasks that independent peers verify and record, so reputation grows layer by layer, like a pearl, not claimed at signup. A fresh identity starts alone, like an island, with no voting or reward rights until it has weeks of verified work. Like yarrow spreading through soil, each identity must build its own history: creating 1,000 credible Sybils would take roughly 1,000 months of attested work, while one honest agent needs only one. Fakes stay cheap to spot and expensive to scale.
